messages:
alex: heads up — PR #8461 (allocator tweak) is sitting green but my canary run showed OOMs on small-batch longseq workloads. attaching quick bench summary below. pinging @maria @jon for 2nd reviews or a hold.

maria: thanks. can you paste the canary job id and the exact command you used? also which model/seq len? :eyes:

alex: canary id: canary-2026-03-16-09. command: `./bench/run.sh --profile=longseq --batch-size=4 --seq=8192 --iters=200 --warmup=20`. model: gptx-7b-qat. saw OOM after ~120 iters on node gpu-12. link: http://perf.internal/reports/canary-3412345678

jon: saw similar spike locally when I rebased and ran a quick smoke. p95 tokens/sec dropped ~18% before the OOMs, memory climbed steadily. not sure if it's alloc fragmentation or kv-cache accounting regression.

bench-bot: benchmark summary (canary-2026-03-16-09):
```
workload: longseq (seq=8192)
batch=4 iters=200
p50: 210 tok/s
p95: 148 tok/s (baseline p95: 182 tok/s)
mem p95: 28.6 GB (baseline: 23.9 GB)
OOMs: 3/200 runs
artifacts: http://perf.internal/artifacts/3412345678/summary.json
```

ci-bot: canary deployment completed; canary metrics flagged regression. auto-fallback NOT triggered (threshold 25%); manual review required.

sam: can you reproduce with `--warmup=0`? curious if warmup hides a leak. also any allocator debug logs?

alex: reproduced with warmup=0, OOM still happens ~130 iters. attaching allocator trace snippet below: 
```
[alloc] t=128s malloc(2147483648) -> 0x7f8e3a000000
[alloc] t=129s free(0x7f8e3a000000)
[alloc] t=130s malloc(1073741824) -> NULL  # OOM
heap fragmentation: 12%\npeak-resident: 29.1G
```

maria: interesting. PR touched the microbatch horizon and the small-batch fast-path in allocator. can you try toggling the new fast-path off? e.g., set `ALLOC_FASTPATH=false` in env and rerun the bench (no code revert).

alex: ran with ALLOC_FASTPATH=false. results: p95 back to 180 tok/s, mem p95 24.1 GB, 0 OOMs in 200 iters. artifacts: http://perf.internal/artifacts/3412345678/nofastpath.json

jon: that strongly implicates fast-path. could be missing a refcount or stale KV slice leading to double-counted usage under longseq. i'll grep the allocator changes.

maria: OK — proposed action: hold the merge until we either fix or gate the fast-path behind a safer feature flag. alex, can you add a defensive check and a small unit test that exercises the fast-path with long sequences? if you push that I'll re-run canary.

alex: will add quick guard and test in PR branch today. estimated ETA ~2hrs. pushing a WIP commit in 15m.

ci-bot: push detected on PR #8461 (commit c7d4f2c). running unit + microbench smoke.

bench-bot: smoke run (post-guard): p95: 176 tok/s, mem p95: 24.4 GB, OOMs: 0/200. details: http://perf.internal/artifacts/3412345678/post-guard.json

maria: thanks. looks acceptable to me. jon — can you give a quick code review on the guard? otherwise i'll +1 and we can merge after green. :thumbsup:

jon: quick skim looks fine, left one comment about clearer var names. otherwise +1 pending CI.

alex: addressed naming nit and pushed (commit d1a9b3e). CI passing.

maria: +1 — go ahead and merge when green. let's follow up with a proper regression test in the perf harness.

alex: merging now. thanks all. :shipit:
